class.name: OpenXRMlPlaneDetectorSettings
class.experimental: Marked as experimental due to lack of community validation on Magic Leap devices.

method.name: get_orientations
method.description: Gets the array of orientations of type [OpenXRMlPlaneTracker.PlaneOrientation] to be tracked by the [OpenXRMlPlaneDetector].

method.name: get_orientations_count
method.description: Gets the number of orientations to be tracked by the [OpenXRMlPlaneDetector].

method.name: get_semantic_types
method.description: Gets the array of semantic types of type [OpenXRMlPlaneTracker.PlaneSemanticType] to be tracked by the [OpenXRMlPlaneDetector].

method.name: get_semantic_types_count
method.description: Gets the number of semantic types to be tracked by the [OpenXRMlPlaneDetector].
